tasks.title: Add the SMTP transport behind MAIL_SERVICE
tasks.description: Add nodemailer and a SmtpMailService that reads host, port, user and password only from environment variables, and make MailModule select SMTP or console from configuration without changing the MAIL_SERVICE token. Widens the MailService interface so a send reports a delivery outcome; the raw token is never logged (AC-046).

tasks.title: Render localized invitation and reset templates
tasks.description: Add EN/AR/FR invitation and password-reset templates that interpolate the clinic name, the role and the accept link built from BACKOFFICE_URL, escaping every value with no dangerouslySetInnerHTML (NFR-017), and have SmtpMailService render them.

tasks.title: Persist the invitation status and delivery outcome
tasks.description: Add the InvitationStatus and DeliveryStatus enums and the status, deliveryStatus, deliveryError and updatedAt columns to the Invitation model with the backfill migration; record the send outcome after the invitation transaction commits, derive EXPIRED at read time for an unconsumed expired row, and never present a failed send as delivered (FR-041, FR-042, AC-048, AC-051).

tasks.title: Paginate and widen the invitation list
tasks.description: Make GET /api/invitations return every status (not just pending) with derived EXPIRED and a bounded page size using the existing indexes, so the directory never loads every invitation for the organization at once (NFR-019).

tasks.title: Add the invitation cancel endpoint
tasks.description: Add PATCH /api/invitations/:id/cancel that cancels a PENDING invitation in the caller's clinic, invalidating the token and writing CANCELLED; refuse a non-pending invitation with a stable code; audit the actor, the invitation and the previous/new status in the same transaction (FR-043).

tasks.title: Add the invitation decline endpoint
tasks.description: Add POST /api/invitations/:token/decline that lets the invitee decline a valid invitation, setting REJECTED and invalidating the token; a declined row stays for the record and the same email and clinic can be invited again (FR-044, EC-020).

tasks.title: Add the membership role-change endpoint
tasks.description: Add PATCH /api/memberships/:id/role gated by CAPABILITY_ROLES and scoped with clinicWhere, updating the membership role and auditing the before/after role, and refusing any change that would leave the organization with zero SUPER_ADMIN members by reusing the v1 invariant (FR-045).

tasks.title: Carry and resolve the link scope with the record as source of truth
tasks.description: Include the target organization id, clinic id and role in the invitation link and add GET /api/invitations/:token that resolves the scope and the email-known flag without consuming the token; on accept re-derive the join scope from the persisted record so a link whose claims disagree is ignored rather than honoured (FR-046, FR-047).

tasks.title: Present the invitation lifecycle on the staff directory
tasks.description: Extend StaffDirectoryPage with a status column (one of PENDING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED), resend and cancel actions, filters, pagination and each member's last login, reading the widened list endpoint (FR-048, NFR-019).

tasks.title: Localise the lifecycle strings and add the role-change and decline controls
tasks.description: Add EN/AR/FR strings for status labels, resend, cancel, decline and role change with RTL-correct layout and no hard-coded user-facing strings, wire the per-member role change on the directory and the decline action on AcceptInvitePage, which asks only for profile and password (NFR-018).

tasks.title: Run the server linter and typechecker
tasks.description: Run pnpm --filter server lint and pnpm --filter server typecheck and resolve every finding without disabling a rule.

tasks.title: Run the formatter check and governance validator
tasks.description: Run pnpm format:check and node .sdrive/scripts/validate-governance.js; both must pass.

tasks.title: Run the spec-to-code verification
tasks.description: Run pnpm sdrive verify authentication-onboarding-and-access-control 2 and account for every reported gap.

tasks.title: Manually confirm the degraded-provider path
tasks.description: With the SMTP credentials unset, confirm an invitation is still created as PENDING with a failed delivery outcome and that the directory offers resend without presenting it as sent (AC-049, EC-019).
